dataset.scope: Authored development set; no independent heldout or human expert validation.
dataset.name: KO96 authored Korean technical-type development set

semif.macro_f1_scope: All eight labels; zero division is zero. Partial runs may have unobserved label supports.
semif.review_definition: Predicted UNKNOWN, failed output, or SemIf score below the chosen threshold. UNKNOWN remains a real gold category in raw accuracy.

diagnostics.sensitive_definition: Technical HEALTH, RELIGION, GOVERNMENT_ID categories; not a legal sensitivity determination.
diagnostics.health_false_alarm_definition: Predicted HEALTH on known non-HEALTH gold; excludes UNKNOWN gold, which is counted as unsupported assertion.
diagnostics.sensitive_type_miss_definition: Any incorrect type on a technical sensitive gold, including confusion between two sensitive types.
diagnostics.sensitive_underflag_definition: Technical sensitive gold predicted OTHER or UNKNOWN, or failed output.

method_notes.semif: Actual pinned upstream SemIf SerialPrefixScorer on local GGUF, adapter korean-cached-contract-v2. The fixed contract moved into shared state and varying untrusted input into the question; this changes prompt arrangement as well as reusing prefix computation. Separate direct-pilot results are not combined. Scores are uncalibrated option-relative preferences.
method_notes.json: Local Ollama constrained JSON output on the same GGUF model and frozen label contract; runtimes differ.
method_notes.rules: Unmodified ml.engine.rule_baseline dictionary/regex comparator; no model inference.
method_notes.failed_output: A completed request attempt with an error counts as incorrect; UNKNOWN is never used as a substitute for an error.
method_notes.partial_denominator: Accuracy uses attempted rows, count. Not-yet-run rows are absent from each method and excluded until attempted.
method_notes.retries: Existing attempts, including failures, are not rerun or replaced automatically.
